summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of CIAP (Crime Intelligence & Analytical Platform). 25/25 backend pytest tests passed covering auth (3 roles), reference data, analytics (KPI, by_district, trends, heatmap, by_crime_head, status_mix), predictive (risk/anomalies/clusters), network (graph/repeat_offenders/offender detail) and cases (list/detail/filters/404). Frontend Playwright tests covered login → dashboard KPIs → all 6 pages (Dashboard, Geo, Network, Predictive, Cases, Offenders) → filters → logout. All flows work; seed data (900 cases, 30 districts, 25 repeat offenders, 1 anomaly signal in Bengaluru Urban Cybercrime) confirmed. Filters update KPIs (Bengaluru Urban → 162 cases). Risk scores show variance (30 rows in leaderboard). Case detail opens; offender dossier loads.

issues: '1 SIGNALS' chip has red border but only 1 signal — grammar nit; ideally singular/plural handling.

Up-arrow trend styled with text-crit (red) for positive week-over-week — semantically red = bad for crime volumes, which is intentional here, but 'up = red' may confuse users familiar with financial dashboards.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:530 week_trend_pct — good, but if prev-week count is 0 returns 0.0 (silent); consider returning null so frontend can render '—'.

server.py:688 risk composite — if hi==lo returns np.zeros_like which yields all-zero risk_score; not currently hit with seeded data, but on empty/single-district filters this would still produce all-zero. Not a bug given current design.
server.py CORS: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine for Bearer-token auth, but future cookie-auth requires explicit origins.
AuthContext: token stored in localStorage (XSS risk). For a police-grade system, prefer httpOnly cookies as noted in auth playbook; acceptable for MVP.
server.py file is 899 lines — nearing 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, analytics.py, predict.py, network.py, cases.py) for maintainability.
GeoMap.js uses OpenStreetMap tiles without a CSS dark-tile filter — tiles render in native colors which may clash with the dark theme; visual only.
Frontend has no error/loading UI states on data fetches (Dashboard/Predictive/etc catch and console.error only); users see blank cards on API failure.
test_credentials: admin@ksp.gov.in/Admin@1234 (SCRB Admin), district@ksp.gov.in/District@1234 (District Officer), station@ksp.gov.in/Station@1234 (Station Officer)
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 3 users + 900 cases + 25 repeat offenders automatically on startup (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_ciap_backend.py — reuse for regression. All data-testids exhaustively covered. Bengaluru Urban Cybercrime anomaly (z~2.67) is deterministic due to seed random 42. If dashboard KPIs shrink or risk table empties, verify /api/analytics/kpi and /api/predict/risk contract first. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and stores JWT in localStorage as ciap_token.
